claim: Stata 18 newey documents lag as maximum autocorrelation lag, OLS point estimates and a Bartlett HAC covariance with n/(n-k) multiplier. The retrieved manual does not document force; it does not validate the author multi-panel call.

limitations: Manual rather than Stata18.5 runtime/ado source; force and filtered multi-panel ordering unresolved.
